title: GRAPHLCP: Structure-Aware Localized Conformal Prediction on Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2605.08074v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides a distribution-free approach to uncertainty quantification with finite-sample guarantees. However, applying CP to graph neural networks (GNNs) remains challenging as the combinatorial nature of graphs often leads to insufficiently certain predictions and indiscriminative embeddings. Existing methods primarily rely on embedding-space proximity for localization, which can be unreliable for graphs and yield uneven coverage across different graph regions. We propose GRAPHLCP, a proximity-based localized CP framework that incorporates graph topology and inter-node dependencies into localization and weighting. Our approach introduces a feature-aware densification step to mitigate locality bias in sparse graphs, followed by a Personalized PageRank-based kernel computation to model structural proximity. translated_title: GRAPHLCP：图上的结构感知局部化保形预测
translated_abstract: 保形预测（CP）提供了一种无分布的不确定性量化方法，并具有有限样本保证。然而，将CP应用于图神经网络（GNN）仍然具有挑战性，因为图的组合特性常常导致预测的不确定性不足以及嵌入缺乏区分度。现有方法主要依赖嵌入空间中的邻近性来进行局部化，这在图上可能并不可靠，并且会导致不同图区域的覆盖率不均匀。我们提出了GRAPHLCP，这是一个基于邻近性的局部化CP框架，它将图拓扑结构和节点间依赖关系融入到局部化和加权过程中。我们的方法引入了一个特征感知的稠密化步骤，以缓解稀疏图中的局部性偏差，随后通过基于个性化PageRank的核计算来建模结构邻近性。这使得拓扑依赖的锚点采样和校准加权成为可能，能够同时捕捉局部和全局的结构信息。
tldr: GRAPHLCP提出了一种将图拓扑结构与节点间依赖关系融入局部化保形预测的框架，通过特征感知稠密化和基于个性化PageRank的结构邻近性核计算，实现了对不同图区域更均匀的覆盖率。
en_tdlr: GRAPHLCP is a localized conformal prediction framework for GNNs that incorporates graph topology and inter-node dependencies through feature-aware densification and Personalized PageRank-based structural proximity kernels, achieving more uniform coverage across different graph regions.
